intro: Your VX-6R has an advantage almost no other handheld has: it transmits on 1.25 m (222–225 MHz). Hardly anyone owns a radio for that band, so it is close to empty across most of the United States — which makes it the cleanest, quietest place to run your own group. The catch is that everyone you talk to needs a 1.25 m radio too. If your group is on ordinary dual-band handhelds, use the 2 m channels instead. Either way, pick one primary, one backup, set a DCS code, and stop there — a channel plan you can remember is worth more than a clever one.
introz: 你的 VX-6R 有一个几乎没有别的手台具备的优势：它能在 1.25 米（222–225 MHz）发射。这个波段几乎没人有对应的设备，所以在美国大部分地方它接近空白——这使它成为你自己团队最干净、最安静的选择。前提是对方也得有 1.25 米的电台。如果你的队友用的是普通双段手台，就用 2 米的频率。无论选哪种，定一个主频、一个备频，设好 DCS 码，就够了——一个你记得住的频率方案，比一个精巧的方案更有价值。

stations.d: Sits in the 223.400–223.520 MHz FM simplex block, two channels below the national calling frequency. On any given day you will almost certainly be the only people on it. Set DCS 315 on both transmit and receive so your squelch stays closed unless it is one of your own radios.
stations.dz: 位于 223.400–223.520 MHz 的 FM 直通段内，在全国呼叫频率下方两个信道。绝大多数日子里，这个频率上只有你们自己。收发都设 DCS 315，这样只有自己人的电台才能打开静噪。

stations.n: Backup — same band, one step up
stations.z: 备频 · 同波段上移一档
stations.d: Move here if the primary is ever occupied. Same DCS code so nobody has to reprogram anything in the field.
stations.dz: 主频被占用时切到这里。DCS 码相同，现场不需要任何人重新设置。

stations.z: 1.25 米全国呼叫 · 请勿占用
stations.d: Monitor it, call on it if you need to find a stranger, but do not use it as your group channel.
stations.dz: 可以守听，需要联系陌生人时可以在此呼叫，但不要当作你们的固定频率使用。

stations.n: Primary — if your group is on dual-band radios
stations.z: 主频 · 队友用双段手台时
stations.d: A long-standing simplex channel inside the 146.400–146.580 MHz block, far enough from the calling frequency to stay clear. Every 2 m handheld ever made can use it, which is the whole point. Busier than 1.25 m, especially in Los Angeles and New York.
stations.dz: 146.400–146.580 MHz 段内的传统直通频率，离呼叫频率足够远。所有 2 米手台都能用，这正是选它的理由。比 1.25 米热闹，在洛杉矶和纽约尤其明显。

stations.d: The 147.420–147.570 MHz simplex block is often quieter than the 146 side in dense cities. Worth trying first in the LA basin.
stations.dz: 147.420–147.570 MHz 直通段在大城市往往比 146 一侧更清静。在洛杉矶盆地建议优先试这里。

stations.z: 2 米全国呼叫 · 请勿占用
stations.d: This is how strangers find each other in the backcountry. Keep it in your radio, keep your conversations off it.
stations.dz: 这是荒野中陌生人互相联系的方式。存进电台里，但不要在上面聊天。

stations.a: 70 cm — better in cities and buildings
stations.d: UHF penetrates buildings and reflects around street canyons better than 2 m, so this is the right choice downtown, in parking structures, at conferences or inside large venues. Range outdoors is shorter than 2 m.
stations.dz: UHF 穿透建筑、在街道峡谷中反射的能力都优于 2 米，所以在市中心、停车楼、会场或大型场馆内部应该用它。室外通信距离比 2 米短。

stations.a: 70 cm — better in cities and buildings
70 cm — better in cities and buildings

stations.z: 70 厘米全国呼叫 · 请勿占用
stations.a: 70 cm — better in cities and buildings

stations.n: GMRS Ch 1 — for friends on consumer radios
stations.z: GMRS 1 频道 · 给用民用电台的朋友
stations.a: If some of your group is on consumer radios
stations.d: GMRS radios are cheap, sold everywhere and need no setup beyond a channel number, which makes them the practical way to put family members on the air. 462 MHz is outside the VX-6R's transmit blocks, so buy proper GMRS sets for the group and let the VX-6 listen.
stations.dz: GMRS 电台便宜、随处有售，除了选个信道之外不需要任何设置，所以是让家人上台最现实的办法。462 MHz 不在 VX-6R 的发射频段内，给团队买正规 GMRS 电台，VX-6 只负责收听。

stations.z: GMRS 20 频道 · 出行互助
stations.a: If some of your group is on consumer radios
If some of your group is on consumer radios
stations.d: 2 W, and unlike FRS it allows an external antenna. Quieter than FRS because far fewer consumer radios ship with it. 151 MHz is outside the VX-6R's transmit blocks too, so this is another buy-the-radios option — the VX-6 can only listen.
stations.dz: 2 瓦，而且与 FRS 不同，允许外接天线。因为很少有民用电台出厂支持它，所以比 FRS 清静得多。151 MHz 同样不在 VX-6R 的发射频段内，所以这也是一个“另买电台”的方案——VX-6 只能收听。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 严禁语音
stations.d: Nationwide position-reporting network. Talking here breaks other people's data.
stations.dz: 全国位置上报网络。在这里说话会破坏别人的数据传输。

stations.d: Reserved for satellite work including the ISS. A handheld here can interfere with someone's once-a-day ten-minute pass.
stations.dz: 保留给卫星通信，包括国际空间站。手台在这里发射，可能毁掉别人一天只有一次、只有十分钟的过顶机会。

stations.d: SSB, CW and moonbounce operators working signals thousands of times weaker than yours. An FM carrier here is extremely rude.
stations.dz: 这里是 SSB、CW 和月面反射通信的领域，他们处理的信号比你弱几千倍。在此发一个 FM 载波非常失礼。

stations.d: Listening is fine and encouraged. These are working channels for aircraft, vessels and emergency services — keep your own traffic off them.
stations.dz: 收听没有问题，也值得鼓励。但这些是航空器、船舶和应急部门的工作频道，请不要把自己的通话放上去。
